layouts.name: Gellerason GP 2019
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Operator full-course T1-T10 plan identifies the north main straight, eastern S, full southern return, central hairpin and western pit corner. The pit strip, short-track connector and later northern kart extension are excluded. Exact source nodes from the consistent 2020 historical snapshot preserve the earlier main-course layout. The timing catalogue distance is retained separately; public mapped length agrees approximately with the operator 2.35-2.4 km course. Fine alignment, travel direction and timing correspondence remain provisional. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 2344.4 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
